title: Johnson's determinantal identity for contiguous minors of Toeplitz matrices, with an accretive extension
summary: Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ real Toeplitz matrix satisfying $A+A^{\top}=2\mathbb J_n$, where $\mathbb J_n$ is the all-ones matrix.If $A_r(i,j)$ denotes the $r\times r$ contiguous submatrix of $A$ consisting of rows $i,i+1,\dots,i+r-1$ and columns $j,j+1,\dots,j+r-1$, then for every $n\ge 2$ one has $$\det A_{n-1}(1,2)+\det A_{n-1}(2,1)=2\det A_{n-1}(1,1).$$ This confirms a conjecture of Charles R.~Johnson (2003).
